name: 74745 · Idabel, OK
findings: ZIP 74745 (Idabel) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (27%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74745 (Idabel) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
50% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 74745 (Idabel) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
